content.short: AdRadar helps Telegram Mini Apps earn ad revenue by routing impressions across multiple ad networks.
content.description: AdRadar is an ad monetization tool for Telegram Mini Apps. Its site says it picks the highest-paying ads from multiple networks in real time through a single integration, so Mini App teams can improve revenue without managing every ad source separately. The product belongs in TON infrastructure because it serves Telegram-native app builders and pays attention to Mini App economics. AdRadar picks the highest-paying ads from multiple networks in real-time. Important product areas are got users, but no revenue?, why adradar?, mini apps store, and our new product.
